name: Feel Energy | 10mg Seltzer | Wildberry Pomegranate
description: Get energized and elevated with the bold, juicy taste of Wildberry Pomegranate. This vibrant, lightly sparkling drink combines 10mg THC and 30mg caffeine from organic green tea for a refreshing lift that keeps you clear and focused. Sweetened naturally with agave and only 20 calories per can, it's vegan, gluten-free, and non-GMO—perfect for a clean, flavorful escape that fits your lifestyle.
